title: Web fuzzing & content discovery (ffuf/gobuster/feroxbuster)
description: Directory/parameter discovery on scoped web targets.
detail: 1) Confirm target/scope and tech. 2) Dir brute with appropriate wordlists; filter by status/size/words. 3) Vhost/subdomain fuzz where relevant. 4) Parameter fuzz (GET/POST) for hidden inputs; feed findings into web-exploitation/api-security. 5) Rate-limit on production; avoid noisy scans on sensitive targets. Record interesting endpoints as service/loot facts.
